title: 6 Fingers, 1 Kidney: Natural Adversarial Medical Images Reveal Critical Weaknesses of Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using AdversarialAnatomyBench, a dataset of paired typical and rare atypical medical images. The methodology measures a 'bias rate,' which calculates the percentage of times the model's answer aligns with strong statistical priors of 'typical' human anatomy (e.g., expecting two kidneys or five fingers) despite clear visual evidence of an atypical anatomical variant (e.g., horseshoe kidney or polydactyly).
